name: Sama Resources Inc.
summary: Sama Resources Inc. explores and develops mineral properties in West Africa. The company focuses on exploring the Samapleu nickel–copper property located in Ivory Coast. It also holds interests in the Zérégouiné property covering an area of approximately 290 square kilometers; the Grata property covering an area of approximately 80 square kilometers; and the Zoupleu property covering an area of approximately 135 square kilometers located in Ivory Coast. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Mont-Royal, Canada.
